div.div: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Orange = geofluid loop (CO2, common.fluid_name), teal = secondary/R245fa loop -- the two never mix, only exchange heat at evaporator/preheater. No downhole pump.

switch.text: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Orange = geofluid loop (CO2, common.fluid_name), teal = secondary/R245fa loop -- the two never mix, only exchange heat at evaporator/preheater. No downhole pump.
